description_en: Retrieves the details of an edge instance
name: GetEdgeInstance

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for the public instance. Specify this parameter for an Enterprise instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the edge instance. On the Edge Instances page of the IoT Platform console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the name of the target edge instance to obtain instance ID.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html operation to obtain instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
边缘实例ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的边缘实例页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html接口获取
parameters.name: instance_id

Code.description_en: The return code. Success indicates a successful call. Other values indicate error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码。Success表示成功，其它表示错误码。详情请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）

Data.description_en: The data returned if the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的数据

BizEnable.description_en:
Indicates whether the edge instance is enabled. Valid values:

true: enabled.
false: disabled
BizEnable.description_zh:
边缘实例是否开启。

true：开启。
false：关闭

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the edge instance was created

GmtCreateTimestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the edge instance was created
GmtCreateTimestamp.description_zh: 创建边缘实例的Unix时间戳

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the edge instance was last updated
GmtModified.description_zh: 最后一次更新边缘实例的时间

GmtModifiedTimestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the edge instance was last updated
GmtModifiedTimestamp.description_zh: 最后一次更新边缘实例的Unix时间戳

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the edge instance

LatestDeploymentStatus.description_en:
The status of the latest deployment task for the edge instance. Valid values:

0: not started (init).
1: in progress (processing).
2: succeeded (success).
3: failed (failure)
LatestDeploymentStatus.description_zh:
边缘实例最近一次部署单的状态。

0：未开始（init）。
1：正在进行（processing）。
2：成功（success）。
3：失败（failure）

LatestDeploymentType.description_en:
The type of the latest deployment task for the edge instance. Valid values:

deploy: deploy.
reset: reset
LatestDeploymentType.description_zh:
边缘实例最近一次部署单的类型。

deploy：部署。
reset：重置

Name.description_en: The name of the edge instance

RoleArn.description_en: The global resource descriptor of the authorization role
RoleArn.description_zh: 授权角色的全局资源描述符

RoleAttachTime.description_en: The time when the role was attached

RoleAttachTimestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the role was attached

RoleName.description_en: The name of the authorized role

Spec.description_en:
The product edition. Valid values:

10: Link IoT Edge Lite Edition.
20: Link IoT Edge Standard Edition.
30: Link IoT Edge Pro Edition
Spec.description_zh:
产品规格。

10：轻量版。
20：标准版。
30：专业版

Tags.description_en: The instance tags of the edge instance. Labels are in the `key:value` format. Multiple labels are separated by commas (,), such as `k1:v1,k2:v2`
Tags.description_zh: 边缘实例标签，标签由`key:value`组成，多个标签以英文逗号隔开，例如`k1:v1,k2:v2`

Type.description_en:
The authorization type of the edge instance. Valid values:

0: owned instance.

1: authorized instance
Type.description_zh:
边缘实例授权类型。

0：自有实例

1：授权实例

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful. true indicates success. false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 表示是否调用成功。true表示调用成功，false表示调用失败
